phases.title: Monorepo skeleton, roadmap tooling, engineering docs, CI and Docker skeleton

No business features.

phases.title: Azure Configuration, Secrets & Entra App Registration
phases.goal: Provision and wire the only permitted Azure resources (one App Configuration store with local-dev and production labels, two Key Vaults, Entra app registrations) so the API and web app boot their configuration securely in both environments with refresh, feature flags and a local fallback.

subPhases.title: Idempotent Azure provisioning scripts
subPhases.scope: Add infra/azure scripts (bash plus PowerShell, az CLI) that create the resource group, one App Configuration store with a sentinel key and labels local-dev/production, Key Vaults for local-dev and production with RBAC authorization and purge protection, and role assignments (App Configuration Data Reader, Key Vault Secrets User, Key Vault Crypto User) for developers and the production service principal, re-runnable with a dry-run flag, a parameter file, printed endpoints and docs/azure/bootstrap.md.
acceptance: bash scripts/azure/provision.sh --dry-run exits 0 without creating or changing any Azure resource: it prints the az deployment group what-if result and every data-plane command it would run.

Running bash scripts/azure/provision.sh twice with the same parameter file leaves the second what-if with no Create or Delete entries and no Modify beyond the server-filled properties listed as what-if noise in docs/operations/azure-bootstrap.md, keeps the sentinel values, key versions and rotation policies unchanged, and both runs exit 0 with the store endpoint and vault URIs printed (verified by the owner-consented run recorded in the pull request).

bash scripts/azure/verify.sh confirms the store has local authentication disabled, both vaults use RBAC with purge protection, Erp:Sentinel exists under the labels local-dev and production, Erp--Platform--DataProtection--Key exists in both vaults, and every row of the documented role matrix (operator, optional developers group with Secrets User and Crypto User on the development vault, optional runtime service principal) is assigned.
bash scripts/azure/check.sh (bicep build with linter errors plus bash syntax checks) passes and runs in node scripts/verify/verify.ts and in the ci-backend workflow.

docs/operations/azure-bootstrap.md documents parameters, script order, access model and recovery; ADR-0010 is accepted and indexed; docs/configuration.md registers the sentinel key and the data-protection key.
subPhases.notes: scripts/azure (bash + Bicep, no PowerShell, replacing the infra/azure wording) provisions rg-erp-ai-pro with the App Configuration store on the Free tier by owner decision, both RBAC vaults with purge protection and a data-protection key each, deterministic role assignments and the labelled Erp:Sentinel keys; the live run, a converged second run and verify.sh are recorded in the pull request; the operator guide lives at docs/operations/azure-bootstrap.md and ADR-0010 records the tier and credential model; the runtime service principal's roles are granted by re-running provision.sh after the app-registration sub-phase.

subPhases.title: Entra app registration scripts
subPhases.scope: Add scripts that create or update per-environment single-tenant app registrations (web redirect URIs signin-oidc/signout-callback-oidc, implicit flow off, app roles from app-roles.json with baseline Erp.User plus Erp.Admin, Graph openid/profile/User.Read consent, api.requestedAccessTokenVersion=2 via az rest), create the service principal with assignment required, create the production automation service principal with a certificate credential (secret fallback) stored in the matching Key Vault, write resulting ids to App Configuration, and verify the registration by reading it back and asserting expected settings.
acceptance: bash scripts/azure/entra.sh creates or updates the registrations named in params.env for local-dev, production and the runtime service principal; running it a second time performs no Microsoft Graph or Key Vault write and exits 0 (verified by the owner-consented runs recorded in the pull request).

bash scripts/azure/verify.sh --entra passes by reading back: single-tenant audience, the documented redirect URIs per environment, implicit grant off, access token version 2, app roles Erp.User and Erp.Admin with their fixed ids, Graph openid/profile/User.Read granted, service principals with assignment required, a key credential matching the Key Vault certificate, and App Configuration keys Erp:Platform:Identity:TenantId and ClientId per label.

The runtime service principal authenticates with a certificate only (no client secret exists on any registration), its certificate lives in kv-erp-ai-pro-prod as PEM, bash scripts/azure/export-runtime-certificate.sh produces a PEM that openssl validates, and after re-running provision.sh the principal holds App Configuration Data Reader plus Key Vault Secrets User and Crypto User on the production vault.

No certificate, key or token value is printed by any script; docs/configuration.md registers the Erp:Platform:Identity ids and both certificate secrets, and docs/operations/azure-bootstrap.md documents the Entra steps and the export procedure.
subPhases.notes: scripts/azure/entra.sh (with lib/graph.sh) converges the three single-tenant registrations ERP-AI-Pro Web (local-dev), ERP-AI-Pro Web (production) and ERP-AI-Pro Runtime (production) with fixed-id app roles, tenant-wide openid/profile/User.Read consent, assignment-required service principals, self-signed Key Vault certificates as the only credentials (no client secret, replacing the roadmap's secret fallback), the operator's Erp.Admin assignment and the per-label Erp:Platform:Identity:TenantId and ClientId (the section the authentication phase binds instead of AzureAd); verify.sh --entra reads 69 assertions back; export-runtime-certificate.sh downloads the runtime PEM for the server; the runtime service principal's roles came from the second provision.sh run; rotation and prune were rehearsed on local-dev; the CI federated credential is not created; production redirect URIs wait for the public host name.

subPhases.title: API configuration bootstrap
subPhases.scope: Implement backend/BuildingBlocks/Configuration: AddAzureAppConfiguration selecting all keys with the null label then the APPCONFIG_LABEL label, sentinel-key refreshAll with the refresh middleware, Key Vault references with secret refresh interval, an App Configuration health check, a credential factory (DefaultAzureCredential with AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS=dev locally, EnvironmentCredential with certificate in production), strongly-typed options with ValidateOnStart, and a local-only fallback to appsettings plus dotnet user-secrets when APPCONFIG_ENDPOINT is unset, covered by unit tests.

subPhases.title: Configuration conventions and seed data
subPhases.scope: Define key naming (`Erp:<Module>:<Setting>`, Key Vault references named `Erp--<Module>--<Secret>`), add config/appconfig.local-dev.json and config/appconfig.production.json with a script that imports them into their labels and creates Key Vault secret placeholders, add an in-memory configuration source for integration tests and CI so the suite needs no Azure access, document how to add a setting, and add tests proving a local-dev label value overrides the unlabelled default.

subPhases.title: Web app runtime configuration
subPhases.scope: Define the Next.js environment contract (server-only vs NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables) validated with Zod at startup in instrumentation.ts, configure the same-origin API base path used by Server Actions and the fetch wrapper, add .env.example, and add a unit test that fails when a required variable is missing.

subPhases.title: Feature management
subPhases.scope: Integrate Microsoft.FeatureManagement with a typed feature catalogue (`Erp.Modules.<Name>` toggles plus named capability flags) read from App Configuration under the environment label, a RequireFeature endpoint filter returning 404 when a module is disabled, a GET /api/features endpoint for UI gating, and unit and integration tests using in-memory flags.

subPhases.title: Secrets hygiene and rotation runbook
subPhases.scope: Write docs/runbooks/secrets.md (naming, rotation steps, refresh intervals, emergency revocation), confirm secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and add a CI grep plus unit test that rejects any committed value resembling a client secret, connection-string password or private key.

phases.title: Backend Platform Kernel
phases.goal: Build the compact shared kernel that user management and every later module plug into before any business feature is written: module contract, persistence conventions and domain primitives, application primitives, HTTP/OpenAPI conventions, transport security, rate limiting and health, observability, migration tooling, and the attachments building block; background jobs and the outbox are deferred to `business-building-blocks` to keep the path to first deployment short.

subPhases.title: Module contract and registration
subPhases.scope: Define IModule (RegisterServices, MapEndpoints(RouteGroupBuilder), migrations assembly, feature-flag key, permission declarations) in backend/BuildingBlocks/Modules with a static module catalogue in the host (no runtime assembly scanning), per-module feature flags from `azure-configuration-feature-management`, and architecture tests enforcing namespace equals folder path, one public entry type per module, and no cross-module references except <Domain>.Contracts projects.

subPhases.title: Persistence conventions: contexts, schemas and ids
subPhases.scope: Implement a ModuleDbContext base with HasDefaultSchema(<module>) and MigrationsHistoryTable per schema, provider selection (UseSqlServer with compatibility level 170 and EnableRetryOnFailure locally, UseAzureSql in production), strongly-typed ids with EF value converters, complex-type value objects, and a sample module proving migrations run against the owner's SQL Server instance in local integration tests and against the SQL Server 2025 service container in CI.

subPhases.title: Persistence conventions: auditing, soft delete and domain primitives
subPhases.scope: Add backend/BuildingBlocks/Domain with Entity and AggregateRoot bases, IAuditable with a CreatedBy/At and ModifiedBy/At interceptor, ISoftDeletable with a named query filter, RowVersion concurrency, UTC DateTimeOffset storage with IST helpers, Money (currency plus minor units with paise rounding), Percentage and Indian financial-year helpers, covered by unit tests.

subPhases.title: Application-layer primitives
subPhases.scope: Add hand-written ICommand/IQuery handler abstractions with convention-based DI registration and pipeline steps (validation, unit of work, logging, transaction), a Result<T> type with typed error kinds mapped to RFC 9457 ProblemDetails, pagination/sorting/safe-filter request contracts, in-process domain events, and an idempotency-key endpoint filter for POST, with unit tests.

subPhases.title: HTTP and OpenAPI conventions
subPhases.scope: Standardise endpoints on TypedResults, per-module validation registration (built-in DataAnnotations validation with the per-assembly source generator), AddProblemDetails plus a global IExceptionHandler, correlation-id middleware, route prefix /api/<domain>/<feature>, an OpenAPI 3.1 document with build-time openapi.json and Scalar UI in Development only, and a generated TypeScript client in frontend/packages/api-client (generator chosen by ADR) with a CI drift check.

subPhases.title: Transport security middleware
subPhases.scope: Configure forwarded headers with KnownIPNetworks from configuration and ForwardLimit 1, HostFiltering with AllowedHosts, HSTS with configurable ramp and HTTPS redirection, security-headers middleware (CSP with nonces, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy), Kestrel AddServerHeader=false and request size limits in the documented middleware order, with integration tests for each header and proxy scenario.

subPhases.title: Rate limiting, output caching and health checks
subPhases.scope: Add a global per-IP limiter chained to a per-user sliding-window policy bound from configuration returning 429 with Retry-After, output caching restricted to explicitly tagged reference-data endpoints, and /healthz/live plus /healthz/ready (SQL, App Configuration) with integration tests for each limiter and probe.

subPhases.title: Observability baseline
subPhases.scope: Add backend/BuildingBlocks/Observability with OpenTelemetry traces/metrics/logs exported over OTLP only when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set, source-generated LoggerMessage conventions enforced by analyzers, ASP.NET Core/Kestrel/HttpClient/EF Core meters, Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience standard handler for outbound HTTP, and the local aspire-dashboard compose profile receiving telemetry.

subPhases.title: Migration tooling and seeding
subPhases.scope: Provide per-context `dotnet ef` wrapper scripts (scripts/ef.ps1 and ef.sh), a CI step running `migrations has-pending-model-changes` for every context, self-contained migration bundle builds per context in CI, the one-shot migrator compose service pattern, and an idempotent ordered seeder framework verified by a test that runs seeding twice.

subPhases.title: Attachments building block
subPhases.scope: Add backend/BuildingBlocks/Attachments with an IDocumentStore abstraction backed by an encrypted, content-addressed Docker volume, metadata in a `files` schema, size and content-type allow-list, virus-scan hook interface, authorised time-limited download endpoint, upload endpoint and a frontend/packages/ui upload component, so every business module stores real files from day one and `documents` extends rather than replaces it.

phases.title: Web Foundation & Design System
phases.goal: Deliver the eye-catching, animated, light/dark UI foundation reused by every feature page: design tokens, feature folder conventions, form and core table kits, feedback/motion/accessibility baseline and the e2e harness matrix; the authenticated app shell follows in `authentication` once sign-in exists.

subPhases.title: Design tokens and theme package
subPhases.scope: Build frontend/packages/ui with OKLch light/dark colour, typography, spacing, radius and motion tokens, shadcn init (Base UI primitives, cssVariables, tw-animate-css, lucide) wired to next-themes class strategy, an @import-able theme CSS shared across the workspace, and a /design/kitchen-sink route rendering every primitive in both themes that Playwright screenshots at desktop and mobile widths.

subPhases.title: Feature folder conventions and routing
subPhases.scope: Establish frontend/apps/web/src/features/<domain>/<module>/<feature>/{components,server,forms,ai} with app/ kept routing-only under (auth) and (app) route groups, typedRoutes, a proxy.ts scaffold, a fetch wrapper skeleton over frontend/packages/api-client with ProblemDetails mapping, and an ESLint boundary rule that fails on cross-feature deep imports.

subPhases.title: Forms and validation kit
subPhases.scope: Create form primitives (field, select/combobox, date and date-range pickers with dd-MM-yyyy, INR currency input with lakh/crore grouping, GSTIN/PAN/IFSC masked inputs, file drop zone using `backend-platform-attachments-building-block`) driven by Zod schemas shared between Server Actions and client, the useActionState submission pattern, and ProblemDetails-to-field-error mapping, each covered by component tests.

subPhases.title: Data table kit (core)
subPhases.scope: Build a server-driven table (TanStack Table + TanStack Query over the generated API client, licences verified) with sorting, filtering, pagination, column visibility, row selection and a mobile card layout backed by the `backend-platform-application-layer-primitives` paginated-query contract; saved views, bulk actions, CSV export and virtualisation follow in `business-building-blocks-web-shared-kit-extensions`.

subPhases.title: Feedback, motion and accessibility baseline
subPhases.scope: Add Sonner toasts, confirm dialogs, empty/error states with retry, skeleton loading states, optimistic-update helpers, page transition and list animation patterns honouring prefers-reduced-motion, and an accessibility baseline (keyboard navigation, focus rings, ARIA labels) enforced by an axe scan step in Playwright that fails on serious violations.

subPhases.title: E2E harness matrix
subPhases.scope: Extend Playwright with per-viewport projects crossed with light/dark, a screenshot naming convention, a nav-crawl helper that visits every registered navigation entry and asserts zero console errors, blob reporter with sharding and merge in CI, and HTML report artifacts; the authentication fixture slot is filled by `authentication-test-authentication-infrastructure`.

phases.title: Authentication (Microsoft Entra ID, BFF)
phases.goal: Implement cookie-based sign-in through Microsoft Entra ID with the API as confidential OIDC client so tokens never reach the browser, plus data protection, antiforgery, bearer scheme for non-browser clients, test authentication, the login page and the authenticated app shell.

subPhases.title: OIDC BFF in the API
subPhases.scope: Configure Microsoft.Identity.Web AddMicrosoftIdentityWebApp from the AzureAd section (auth code + PKCE, single tenant, explicit default and challenge schemes), /api/auth/login with validated relative-only returnUrl, /api/auth/logout and callback paths, hardened cookie options (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, sliding expiry), a fallback RequireAuthenticatedUser policy with an explicit AllowAnonymous allow-list, 401 ProblemDetails instead of redirects for XHR requests, and integration tests using a TestAuthHandler scheme.

subPhases.title: Token cache and Data Protection key ring
subPhases.scope: Add AddDistributedTokenCaches backed by the SQL Server IDistributedCache (in-memory in Development), persist Data Protection keys to a named Docker volume with ProtectKeysWithAzureKeyVault using a versionless key identifier and SetApplicationName, fail fast when the vault key is unreachable in production, and add a test proving cookies survive an app restart.

subPhases.title: Antiforgery for JSON endpoints
subPhases.scope: Add AddAntiforgery with header X-XSRF-TOKEN, a GET /api/auth/antiforgery endpoint setting a non-HttpOnly XSRF-TOKEN cookie, an endpoint filter validating POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on every cookie-authenticated group, the web fetch wrapper attaching the header, and integration tests for missing and invalid tokens.

subPhases.title: Session endpoints, OpenAPI security and bearer scheme
subPhases.scope: Implement GET /api/auth/me (id, name, email, Entra roles, permissions placeholder) and a session-ping endpoint, describe cookie and XSRF security schemes in the OpenAPI document, and register AddMicrosoftIdentityWebApi as a JWT bearer scheme behind a feature flag with per-group scheme selection, scope and app-role checks and integration tests with a test token issuer for later integrations and mobile.

subPhases.title: Test authentication infrastructure
subPhases.scope: Expose the TestAuthHandler scheme and an E2E-only login endpoint issuing the real auth cookie for seeded users solely when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Testing (never in production images), add Playwright fixtures using it into the `web-foundation-e2e-harness-matrix` slot, and document a manual smoke run with a real Entra test user.

subPhases.title: Web login page and session integration
subPhases.scope: Build the animated branded /login page (root redirects here when unauthenticated) with a Microsoft sign-in button starting the API challenge, complete proxy.ts with the optimistic session-cookie check and relative-only returnUrl validation, hydrate user context from /api/auth/me, implement sign-out with Entra front-channel logout and session-expired handling that returns the user to their page after re-login, with e2e on desktop and mobile in light and dark with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Authenticated application shell
subPhases.scope: Implement the (app) layout with a collapsible sidebar generated from a typed, permission-gated module/feature navigation registry, top bar with command palette (Ctrl+K), breadcrumbs, user menu and theme toggle, responsive drawer navigation on phones, and React ViewTransition route transitions, covered by the nav-crawl e2e on desktop and mobile in light and dark with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Login hardening
subPhases.scope: Apply strict rate limiting to auth endpoints, record sign-in/sign-out/failure events in an audit table, verify security headers and cookie flags with a Playwright test, and write docs/security/auth-threat-model.md covering CSRF, session fixation, open redirects and token leakage.

phases.title: User Management & Authorisation
phases.goal: Manage employees as ERP users (contractors are vendors), their profiles, departments, designations, roles and permissions with a full audit trail, forming the first business module, the hand-built reference for the `business-building-blocks-module-and-feature-scaffolders` scaffolder and the gate for the first deployment.

subPhases.title: Users module and just-in-time provisioning
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Identity/Users with a User aggregate linked to the Entra object id (employee code, display name, work email, phone, designation, date of joining, status) in schema `identity`, create or update the user from Entra claims on first sign-in, deny sign-in for deactivated users, bootstrap the first administrator from configuration, and add admin CRUD endpoints with validation plus unit and integration tests.

subPhases.title: Directory invitation via Microsoft Graph
subPhases.scope: Add an invitation flow that searches directory users through Microsoft Graph, pre-registers invitees with an intended role, matches them by object id or email on first login, and covers the flow with integration tests using a fake Graph client.

subPhases.title: Roles and permissions
subPhases.scope: Add a permission catalogue generated from module declarations (e.g. finance.sales.invoices.approve), Role and RolePermission entities with seeded system roles (Owner, Admin, Finance, HR, Manager, Employee) mapped from Entra app roles, a permission authorisation handler and RequirePermission endpoint extension with permission claims returned by /api/auth/me, and an architecture test that every non-anonymous endpoint declares a permission.

subPhases.title: Departments, designations and reporting lines
subPhases.scope: Model a department tree, designations, manager assignment with effective dates, position history and an org-chart query exposed through admin endpoints under /api/identity/organisation, consumed by approvals and timesheets later and extended (not replaced) by `hr-core`.

subPhases.title: Audit trail building block
subPhases.scope: Add backend/BuildingBlocks/Auditing with an EF Core SaveChanges interceptor recording append-only entries (actor, timestamp, before/after JSON diff, IP, correlation id) into an `audit` schema for user, role and department changes, a filterable exportable audit endpoint, an audit timeline component, and an architecture test requiring aggregates to implement IAuditable.

subPhases.title: Web: users, roles and permissions
subPhases.scope: Build the users list (data table with search, sort, filter, pagination, mobile cards), user detail and create/edit forms, role assignment dialog and a roles/permissions matrix page, with Playwright clicking every control on desktop and mobile in light and dark with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: invitations, organisation and my profile
subPhases.scope: Build the invite dialog with directory search, department and designation admin pages with an org-tree preview, and my-profile with Graph photo and theme preference, with e2e on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: User lifecycle
subPhases.scope: Implement deactivate/reactivate with immediate session invalidation via a server-side security stamp validated on each request, an offboarding checklist hook for `hr-core`, and the contract for the nightly Entra directory sync job that `business-building-blocks-background-jobs-and-scheduling` schedules to flag disabled or deleted accounts.

phases.title: First On-Prem Deployment
phases.goal: Take API, web app, migrator and reverse proxy live on the Ubuntu home server with Docker Compose, TLS, secrets, health gating, backups and a repeatable, attestation-verified deployment pipeline; closes M3 with user management as the only business module.

subPhases.title: Production compose stack
subPhases.scope: Complete infra/compose/compose.yaml and compose.production.yaml with proxy, api, web and one-shot migrator services, named volumes (data-protection keys, attachments, proxy certificates), hardened settings (read_only with tmpfs, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, resource limits, log rotation, restart unless-stopped, healthcheck on every service, depends_on service_healthy), file-backed secrets for the service-principal certificate, profiles so SQL Server never starts in production, and `docker compose config` validation in CI.

subPhases.title: Production database provisioning
subPhases.scope: Provision Azure SQL (serverless free offer or small provisioned tier, recorded as an ADR) with an Entra admin, contained users for the app (data role) and migrator (schema role), service-principal connection strings stored in Key Vault, firewall rules for the home server, the free-amount-remaining alert, and a documented fallback to a SQL Server Express container.

subPhases.title: Host bootstrap runbook and scripts
subPhases.scope: Write docs/runbooks/host-setup.md and infra/compose/host scripts for Ubuntu hardening (unattended upgrades, ufw, fail2ban, SSH keys only), Docker Engine install, non-root deploy user, mounted service-principal certificate, .env for non-secret values, DNS and router port-forwarding, and a systemd unit running `docker compose up -d --wait`.

subPhases.title: Reverse proxy and TLS
subPhases.scope: Configure the edge proxy (Caddy with automatic TLS as default, nginx+certbot as alternative, recorded as an ADR) routing /api/* to api:8080 and everything else to web:3000, TLS 1.2+, HSTS ramp-up, forwarded headers with KnownIPNetworks equal to the compose subnet, security headers, request size limits, streaming buffering off and no host-published ports other than 80/443, verified by a local end-to-end run through the proxy including the Entra redirect flow.

subPhases.title: Release and deploy pipeline
subPhases.scope: Add a release workflow on v* tags building and pushing images with SBOM, provenance, attestations and the CVE gate, and host-side deploy.sh and rollback.sh that pull by digest, run `gh attestation verify`, execute the migrator, roll api/web with health-gated cutover, prune, and roll back to the previous digest on failure, with a shellcheck CI job.

subPhases.title: Health probes and uptime monitoring
subPhases.scope: Provide a shell-less health probe for the chiseled API image (tiny .NET probe entrypoint or proxy-side active checks), a /api/health route in the web app, compose healthcheck definitions and an external uptime monitor hitting /healthz/live through the proxy with alerting to the owner.

subPhases.title: Backups and restore drill
subPhases.scope: Verify Azure SQL automated backups and PITR retention, back up the data-protection key volume, attachments volume and compose configuration nightly to an encrypted off-host location, and rehearse a full restore documented in docs/runbooks/restore.md with measured RTO/RPO.

subPhases.title: Go-live checklist and production smoke
subPhases.scope: Run a production Playwright smoke project (real Entra test user via stored auth state, users list renders, sign-out) against the live URL, confirm traces and logs arrive, complete docs/runbooks/go-live-checklist.md, record ADR deployment topology, and mark milestone M3 done in the roadmap.

phases.title: Business Building Blocks & Reference Data
phases.goal: Immediately after the first deployment, add the reusable infrastructure every business module needs before clients and finance are built: background jobs, transactional outbox, scaffolders, reference data, the effective-dated statutory parameter store, numbering series, one shared minimal approvals block, a minimal email sender, the extended web kit and developer experience.

subPhases.title: Background jobs and scheduling
subPhases.scope: Implement backend/BuildingBlocks/Jobs with a persistent job table with idempotency keys, retry with exponential backoff, dead-letter state, cron-style recurring schedules in IST, a hosted runner with graceful shutdown, admin endpoints to list/re-run/cancel jobs, an in-process fake for tests, and the nightly Entra directory sync from `user-management-user-lifecycle` as the first recurring job.

subPhases.title: Transactional outbox and integration events
subPhases.scope: Add a per-module outbox table written in the same transaction as domain changes, a dispatcher running on the `business-building-blocks-background-jobs-and-scheduling` runner publishing integration events in-process to <Domain>.Contracts subscribers with at-least-once delivery and idempotent handlers, covered by integration tests.

subPhases.title: Module and feature scaffolders
subPhases.scope: Create a `dotnet new erp-module` template package (templates/erp-module) generating Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Endpoints/Ai folders, DbContext with schema and migrations factory, IModule registration and matching test projects under backend/Modules/<Domain>/<Feature>/, and a `pnpm scaffold:feature` script generating frontend/apps/web/src/features/<domain>/<feature>/ with route, list/detail pages and an e2e spec, both derived from the `user-management` reference module and verified by architecture tests on generated output.

subPhases.title: Reference data module
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/ReferenceData with countries, Indian States and UTs with GST State codes, currencies, a dated exchange-rate table with manual entry and file import, fiscal-year and period services (April to March), seed migrations, cached read endpoints and reusable UI pickers, with tests.

subPhases.title: Statutory parameter store and GST datasets
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Compliance/StatutoryParameters with effective-dated, versioned parameter sets seeded from statutory/*.json, an `IStatutoryParameters.GetAsOf(date)` service, list/read endpoints, an admin viewer page with version diff, and the first datasets (GST rate schedule with history, SAC/HSN master seeded with 9983xx and 997331, State codes, GST due-date rules) pinned by golden-value tests.

subPhases.title: Statutory datasets: direct tax and labour
subPhases.scope: Seed and golden-test TDS sections with the ITA-1961 to ITA-2025 crosswalk, rates, per-FY thresholds, no/inoperative-PAN and 206AB non-filer rates, company income-tax rates and surcharge, advance-tax schedule, professional-tax State slabs, PF/ESI ceilings and rates (including the pending PF ceiling revision), LWF, gratuity and bonus parameters, and Companies Act Schedule II useful lives with income-tax block rates.

subPhases.title: Document numbering series
subPhases.scope: Provide configurable number series per document type and financial year (max 16 characters, unique per FY, prefix and reset rules) with gap-free concurrent allocation proven by a parallel integration test.

subPhases.title: Shared minimal approvals building block
subPhases.scope: Add backend/BuildingBlocks/Approvals with an ApprovalRequest entity bound to any aggregate by generic reference, a state machine (submitted, approved, rejected, returned, withdrawn), approver resolution by manager or role, SLA reminder jobs, endpoints and an approvals inbox page, used by vendors, bills, payouts, reimbursements and timesheets until `approvals-workflow-consumer-migration` migrates them (tag bridge).

subPhases.title: Minimal transactional email sender
subPhases.scope: Add backend/BuildingBlocks/Email with Microsoft Graph sendMail from a shared mailbox, a dark-mode-safe HTML template base, attachment support, a delivery log, a local dev mail-sink compose profile and SPF/DKIM/DMARC documentation, used for invoice delivery, approval requests and reminders until `notifications` generalises it (tag bridge).

subPhases.title: Web shared kit extensions
subPhases.scope: Extend frontend/packages/ui with advanced table features (saved views, bulk actions, CSV export, virtualised rows), list/detail/wizard page templates, entity activity timeline and document tab components, and demonstrate them on a hidden /kit route covered by e2e screenshots.

subPhases.title: Developer experience
subPhases.scope: Add a dev container, a one-command local stack (`pnpm dev:all` starting SQL Server, aspire-dashboard, API and web), a seed-data generator for realistic demo data, and a module documentation index with module SDK docs.

phases.title: Clients (Customer Master & Engagements)
phases.goal: Model the customers the company bills with Indian tax identity, contacts, engagements and rate cards, a tax profile and a pre-client pipeline, providing everything invoicing, timesheets and projects need.

subPhases.title: Client aggregate
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Clients/Core with legal/trade name, client type (domestic B2B, domestic B2C, export, SEZ, deemed export), GSTIN with checksum and State-code validation, PAN with GSTIN consistency, TAN, CIN, MSME flag, billing/shipping addresses with PIN and State, country and currency, default payment terms, status lifecycle, tags and duplicate detection, plus CRUD endpoints in schema `clients` and tests.

subPhases.title: Contacts
subPhases.scope: Add multiple contacts per client with roles (billing, technical, signatory), preferred channel, portal-access flag, and de-duplication rules on email/phone with merge support.

subPhases.title: Engagements and rate cards
subPhases.scope: Model MSA/SOW engagements with effective dates, billing model (time-and-materials, fixed, retainer, milestone), rate cards per role and currency, client PO numbers, SOW documents via `backend-platform-attachments-building-block` and renewal reminders through `business-building-blocks-background-jobs-and-scheduling` jobs.

subPhases.title: Client tax profile
subPhases.scope: Implement a tax-profile service returning the GST treatment for a client (intra-State CGST+SGST, inter-State IGST, export/SEZ zero-rated with LUT), expected client-side TDS section/rate and foreign-exchange settings from the statutory store, with a golden-value test table covering every client type.

subPhases.title: Web: client list, wizard and import
subPhases.scope: Build the client list with facets, a create/edit wizard with GSTIN formatting and CSV import with dry-run preview, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: client 360
subPhases.scope: Build the client 360 page (overview, contacts, engagements, tax, documents, activity and audit tabs) with inline editing, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Activity feed and health widgets
subPhases.scope: Aggregate integration events from other modules (invoices, receipts, projects) via `business-building-blocks-transactional-outbox-and-integration-events` into a per-client activity timeline and define the receivables/health widget contract consumed by dashboards.

subPhases.title: Leads and opportunities
subPhases.scope: Add Clients/Pipeline with lead and opportunity records (source, stage, value, probability, owner, next step), a stage board UI, conversion to client plus engagement, and pipeline reports, with e2e.

phases.title: Vendors (Suppliers & Contractors)
phases.goal: Model suppliers and individual contractors (contractors are vendors, never employees) with the Indian tax attributes that drive TDS, reverse charge, MSME and foreign-remittance rules; closes M4.

subPhases.title: Vendor aggregate
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Vendors/Core with legal name, vendor type (company, individual/contractor, foreign), PAN with entity-type character parsing, GST status (registered, unregistered, composition, overseas), Udyam number and MSE classification, residency/country, TRC and Form 10F on file, bank details with IFSC validation and UPI id, default expense category, status lifecycle and duplicate detection, plus CRUD endpoints in schema `vendors` and tests.

subPhases.title: Vendor tax profile
subPhases.scope: Add Vendors/Tax with default TDS section mapping (ITA-1961 code and ITA-2025 table item), lower/nil deduction certificates with validity and cap, 206AB non-filer and inoperative-PAN flags, RCM applicability flags (advocate, GTA, non-employee director, foreign supplier, unregistered commercial rent), MSME due-date rule (45 days, 15 without agreement), and a service returning TDS/RCM treatment for a payment date covered by golden-value tests.

subPhases.title: Contractor agreements
subPhases.scope: Model contractor contracts (rate, currency, period, SOW, deliverables, notice, reporting manager, linked client engagement for pass-through billing) with expiry reminders via jobs and SOW documents via `backend-platform-attachments-building-block`.

subPhases.title: Onboarding and KYC
subPhases.scope: Implement an onboarding checklist (PAN, GST certificate, cancelled cheque, MSME certificate) with uploaded evidence, verification status, an adapter interface for bank-account penny-drop verification, and approval through the `business-building-blocks-shared-minimal-approvals-building-block` block.

subPhases.title: Web: vendor list, wizard and import
subPhases.scope: Build the vendor list with facets, an onboarding wizard and CSV import with dry-run, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: vendor 360 and KYC
subPhases.scope: Build the vendor 360 (overview, tax, bank, contracts, documents, audit tabs), the contractor view and the KYC checklist UI, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Vendor activity and MSME exposure
subPhases.scope: Aggregate bills, payments and on-time metrics from integration events into vendor activity and define the MSME 45-day exposure widget contract used by `finance-expenses` and `compliance`.

phases.title: AI platform core and first consumers
phases.goal: Provide the single governed AI layer (IChatClient pipeline over Microsoft.Extensions.AI, prompt and tool registry, structured output, document intelligence, retrieval and semantic search, assistant UX, evaluation and safety, agent runtime) before the finance modules so that every domain ships its AI capabilities inline; closes M5 with the first consumers in user management, clients and vendors.

subPhases.title: Core AI infrastructure
subPhases.scope: Create backend/BuildingBlocks/Ai with a Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient pipeline (Azure OpenAI in an Indian region, function invocation, OpenTelemetry, redacting logging, distributed cache, retry and backoff), IEmbeddingGenerator, provider settings in App Configuration with credentials from Key Vault, per-feature model routing with fallback, a fake chat client for tests, an architecture test forbidding provider SDK usage outside backend/BuildingBlocks/Ai, and a health check.

subPhases.title: Prompt and tool registry
subPhases.scope: Add versioned prompt templates in-repo with snapshot tests, an AIFunction tool catalogue exposing permission-checked ERP queries and actions with tool-call auditing, structured-output schema helpers, a suggestion-versus-commit review contract, a PII redaction filter, and per-user/per-feature token and cost accounting with budgets and alerts.

subPhases.title: Document intelligence pipeline
subPhases.scope: Build upload-to-structured-JSON extraction for PDFs and images (text and vision) over `backend-platform-attachments-building-block`, confidence scoring and a human-review queue UI used by bills, receipts, vendor KYC and client enrichment, with evaluation fixtures.

subPhases.title: Retrieval, grounded Q&A and semantic search
subPhases.scope: Store embeddings for policies, SOPs, statutory notes, module docs and entity summaries (clients, vendors, invoices) in SQL Server 2025 vector columns, implement permission-aware retrieval, a grounded assistant with citations and a global semantic search endpoint wired to the `authentication-authenticated-application-shell` command palette, with evaluation tests on a fixed corpus.

subPhases.title: Assistant UX
subPhases.scope: Build frontend/apps/web/src/features/ai with a global assistant panel streaming via Server-Sent Events, page-context suggestions, action confirmation cards, feedback capture and per-user conversation history, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile.

subPhases.title: Evaluation and safety
subPhases.scope: Add an offline evaluation suite (golden prompts and expected outputs) run on a sample in CI, red-team and prompt-injection tests for document-derived text, an audit log of AI-initiated actions, per-capability feature flags and an AI usage policy page.

subPhases.title: Agent runtime
subPhases.scope: Adopt Microsoft Agent Framework (once its provider packages are stable, recorded as an ADR) over the IChatClient pipeline and tool registry with human-in-the-loop checkpoints through `approvals-workflow-workflow-runtime` approvals, sandboxed execution and auditing, with tests (dependsOn `approvals-workflow-workflow-runtime`).

subPhases.title: Agent scenarios
subPhases.scope: Implement a month-end close assistant, a collections agent and an onboarding agent with evaluation suites and feature flags.

subPhases.title: Agent console
subPhases.scope: Build a console for agent runs, pending approvals and traces, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: user administration assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Identity/Users/Ai with natural-language user search and role suggestion from designation using IChatClient structured output behind a feature flag with mandatory human confirmation.

subPhases.title: AI: client enrichment
subPhases.scope: Add Clients/Ai to enrich a client from a website or email signature into structured fields, detect duplicate clients with explanations and draft engagement summaries via structured output.

subPhases.title: AI: vendor data extraction
subPhases.scope: Add Vendors/Ai to extract vendor master data from GST certificate, PAN card or invoice images into a review form with per-field confidence, suggest TDS section from vendor type and service description, and flag KYC anomalies.

phases.title: Finance Core: Ledger, Fiscal Calendar, FX & Tax Engine
phases.goal: Lay the accounting foundation every finance feature posts into: Schedule III chart of accounts, MCA-compliant journals, fiscal calendar, currencies and FX, the GST tax engine, company profile and financial reports.

subPhases.title: Chart of accounts and cost centres
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Finance/Core/Ledger in schema `finance` with an account tree grouped for Schedule III seeded from an Indian small-company template, cost centres, and account CRUD endpoints with tests.

subPhases.title: Journals and posting
subPhases.scope: Implement double-entry journal entries with balanced-posting validation, posting-period locks, immutable posted journals with reversal entries, the Companies (Accounts) Rules audit-trail/edit-log requirement and 8-year books retention, and trial-balance/GL queries covered by tests.

subPhases.title: Fiscal calendar and year-end close
subPhases.scope: Model the April-March financial year with periods, opening balances, role-based period locking, a year-end close checklist and tax-year alignment with the Income-tax Act 2025.

subPhases.title: Currency and FX
subPhases.scope: Add INR as reporting currency over the `business-building-blocks-reference-data-module` rate table, realised and unrealised gain-loss journal generation, period-end revaluation, and GST-compliant rounding rules with unit tests on paise handling.

subPhases.title: GST tax engine
subPhases.scope: Implement Finance/Core/Tax determining place of supply (Section 12 intra/inter-State, Section 13 export and SEZ zero-rated with LUT), splitting CGST/SGST/IGST with rounding, applying RCM and exemption flags, resolving rates by date from the statutory store and computing tax on advances, with fixture-driven golden tests reused by sales, expenses and procurement.

subPhases.title: Company profile
subPhases.scope: Model the legal entity (legal name, CIN, PAN, TAN, GSTINs per State, LUT number per FY, IEC, Udyam, PF/ESI/PT registrations, registered address, signatory, logo, bank-account references) with multi-GSTIN readiness, identifier format validation and admin API.

subPhases.title: Financial reports
subPhases.scope: Deliver trial balance, P&L, balance sheet (Schedule III layout) and GL detail reports with period filters and Excel/CSV export, with fixture-based tests.

subPhases.title: Web: finance admin
subPhases.scope: Build screens for accounts, journals and posting, periods and close checklist, statutory parameter sets, company profile and the four reports, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: ledger assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Finance/Core/Ai translating natural-language questions into safe parameterised report definitions with a preview step and flagging unusual journal entries with explanations.

phases.title: Finance / Sales & Invoicing (GST)
phases.goal: Issue GST-compliant tax invoices, credit/debit notes, advance receipt vouchers and export invoices, record receipts, manage receivables and dunning, and produce GSTR-1 and e-invoice data.

subPhases.title: Invoice aggregate and lifecycle
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Finance/Sales/Invoicing in schema `sales` with the Rule 46 field set, client snapshot, line items (SAC, quantity, unit, taxable value, discount), tax computed by `finance-core-gst-tax-engine`, RCM flag, export endorsement text and LUT reference, foreign currency with INR conversion, a draft/issued/paid/cancelled state machine, numbering via `business-building-blocks-document-numbering-series` and the Rule 47 30-day issuance warning, all covered by golden tax-computation tests.

subPhases.title: Invoice PDF rendering
subPhases.scope: Render invoices as PDF in the Rule 46 layout with branding, export endorsement and a QR placeholder through a Finance/Sales/Documents service, with snapshot tests of rendered output (consolidated by `documents-generated-documents-service` later).

subPhases.title: Credit and debit notes
subPhases.scope: Implement notes linked to one or more original invoices with reason codes, partial amounts, tax recomputation, a separate numbering series and 30-November cut-off warnings for the previous financial year, with tests.

subPhases.title: Advances and receipt vouchers
subPhases.scope: Record advances received against engagements with GST receipt vouchers and tax on advance where applicable, refund vouchers, and automatic adjustment of the advance and its tax on the subsequent invoice, with golden tests.

subPhases.title: Receipts and allocation
subPhases.scope: Record receipts (bank, UPI, cheque, foreign remittance with FIRC reference and realisation date), allocate them to invoices, handle client-deducted TDS and short-payment write-offs, and post FX gain/loss journals, with API and tests.

subPhases.title: Receivables, dunning and TDS receivable
subPhases.scope: Provide receivables ageing, 9-month export realisation ageing, a dunning ladder with reminder jobs sending through `business-building-blocks-minimal-transactional-email-sender`, and a TDS-receivable ledger reconciled against 26AS/AIS CSV imports, with tests.

subPhases.title: GSTR-1 extracts
subPhases.scope: Generate GSTR-1 tables (B2B 4A, B2CL/B2CS, EXP 6A, CDNR 9B, HSN 12, document summary 13) for monthly or quarterly periods as JSON/Excel matching the GST offline tool, with fixture-based tests.

subPhases.title: E-invoicing adapter
subPhases.scope: Model the IRP e-invoice schema payload, IRN and signed QR storage and printing, and a sandbox client abstraction behind an AATO-driven feature flag, with contract tests that need no live credentials.

subPhases.title: Recurring and retainer billing
subPhases.scope: Add billing schedules per engagement, proforma invoices, auto-drafted invoices from approved timesheets or milestones through a contract consumed by `timesheets` and `projects`, and a monthly billing-run job with a review queue.

subPhases.title: Web: invoice builder and notes
subPhases.scope: Build the invoice builder with live tax preview, invoice list with status facets, credit/debit note and advance flows, and PDF preview/download with email delivery through `business-building-blocks-minimal-transactional-email-sender` and a delivery log, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: receipts and receivables
subPhases.scope: Build the receipt allocation UI, receivables dashboard with ageing and dunning status, TDS-receivable reconciliation and GSTR-1 export page, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: invoicing assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Finance/Sales/Ai to draft invoice lines from a description or SOW, suggest SAC codes, flag rate and place-of-supply anomalies before issue, score collection risk per client and draft payment-reminder text.

phases.title: Finance / Expenses & Vendor Bills (TDS, RCM, ITC, MSME)
phases.goal: Record purchases and expenses, compute and deposit TDS, handle reverse-charge GST, track input tax credit against GSTR-2B/IMS and enforce MSME payment discipline.

subPhases.title: Bill and expense aggregate
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Finance/Expenses/Bills in schema `expenses` with vendor bills and lines, vendor snapshot, expense categories mapped to ledger accounts, GST treatment (eligible, ineligible, blocked under 17(5)), currency and FX, attachments via `backend-platform-attachments-building-block`, approval through `business-building-blocks-shared-minimal-approvals-building-block` and journal posting, with tests.

subPhases.title: Reverse charge documents
subPhases.scope: Detect RCM (notified categories and import of services including foreign SaaS), generate self-invoices within 30 days and payment vouchers, and post the RCM liability and eligible credit, with golden tests.

subPhases.title: TDS computation engine
subPhases.scope: Implement Finance/Expenses/Tds computing deductions per vendor and section selected by credit/payment date with per-FY single and aggregate thresholds, lower-deduction certificates, 20% no/inoperative-PAN and 206AB rules, and Section 195/DTAA handling, pinned by golden tests.

subPhases.title: TDS ledger, challans and statements
subPhases.scope: Maintain a TDS ledger, monthly challan batches due by the 7th, quarterly TDS statement extracts (form numbering verified against current ITA-2025 rules at implementation time) and Form 16A tracking, with fixture tests.

subPhases.title: ITC and GSTR-2B/IMS reconciliation
subPhases.scope: Maintain a purchase register, import GSTR-2B JSON, match invoices with mismatch reasons, record accept/reject/pending per inward invoice, raise 180-day non-payment reversal alerts and output GSTR-3B Table 3.1(d) and 4 figures, with tests.

subPhases.title: MSME 45-day compliance
subPhases.scope: Compute due dates from acceptance/invoice date and agreed terms, calculate interest at three times the RBI bank rate compounded monthly, and generate the half-yearly MSME-1 extract and a Section 43B(h) year-end disallowance report, with tests.

subPhases.title: Recurring expenses and subscriptions feed
subPhases.scope: Support recurring bill templates (SaaS, rent, utilities) including foreign SaaS as import of services under IGST RCM, cost allocation to cost centres/projects and a renewal calendar feeding `procurement-assets-subscriptions-and-licences`.

subPhases.title: Web: bill entry and list
subPhases.scope: Build bill entry with vendor defaults, attachment zone and live TDS/RCM/ITC preview, and the bills list with facets and approval actions, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: TDS, ITC and MSME workbenches
subPhases.scope: Build the TDS dashboard and challan batch UI, the GSTR-2B reconciliation workbench and the MSME ageing view, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: bill intelligence
subPhases.scope: Add Finance/Expenses/Ai for bill OCR to Rule 46 fields with per-field confidence and review, expense categorisation and ledger-account suggestion, duplicate-bill detection and TDS/RCM applicability explanations.

phases.title: Finance / Banking & Payments
phases.goal: Manage bank accounts, execute vendor, employee and tax payouts, import statements, reconcile every transaction, track export remittances and forecast cash.

subPhases.title: Bank accounts and cash book
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Finance/Banking/Accounts in schema `banking` with account types (current, overdraft, EEFC), opening balances, cash and petty-cash books, UPI ids and signatories, posting to the ledger, with tests.

subPhases.title: Payout batches
subPhases.scope: Build Finance/Banking/Payouts creating batches from due bills, reimbursements, payroll and tax challans with rail selection enforcing limits (RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, UPI), pluggable bulk-file exporters (generic CSV plus one major bank template), maker-checker approval via `business-building-blocks-shared-minimal-approvals-building-block`, status tracking and UTR capture, with tests.

subPhases.title: Statement import
subPhases.scope: Implement CSV/XLSX/MT940 importers with saved bank-format mapping profiles, de-duplication and categorisation rules, with sample-file tests.

subPhases.title: Reconciliation
subPhases.scope: Auto-match transactions to receipts, bills, claims, payroll and challans on amount/date/reference/UTR with tolerance rules, suggested matches, manual match and split, unreconciled-item ageing and a bank reconciliation statement report, with tests.

subPhases.title: Inward remittances and export documentation
subPhases.scope: Capture foreign inward remittances with purpose code, bank charges, FX rate and FIRC/e-FIRA reference, link them to export invoices, and track e-BRC status and SOFTEX/EDPMS filing status for software exports, with tests.

subPhases.title: Cash-flow forecasting
subPhases.scope: Produce a 13-week cash-flow projection from receivables, payables, payroll and the compliance calendar with scenario adjustments, exposed as a dashboard widget.

subPhases.title: Web: accounts and payouts
subPhases.scope: Build bank account pages, the payout batch wizard and export download, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: reconciliation and remittances
subPhases.scope: Build the keyboard-driven reconciliation workbench, statement import wizard, remittance capture and cash-flow dashboard, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: banking assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Finance/Banking/Ai for statement-line categorisation and counterparty matching suggestions with explanations and a cash-flow risk narrative.

phases.title: Finance / Reimbursements & Employee Expenses
phases.goal: Let employees claim expenses and advances with policy checks, approvals and payroll- and tax-correct settlement; closes M5.

subPhases.title: Claims aggregate
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Finance/Reimbursements/Claims in schema `reimbursements` with claim lines (category, date, amount, GST details when ITC-eligible, receipt attachment), advances and settlement, and a draft/submitted/approved/rejected/paid state machine, with tests.

subPhases.title: Policy engine
subPhases.scope: Implement per-category and per-grade caps, receipt-required thresholds, per-diem and mileage rules, duplicate-receipt detection, corporate-card versus personal-paid distinction and tax-treatment mapping of claim heads (exempt or taxable) that feeds payroll, with unit tests.

subPhases.title: Approval routing
subPhases.scope: Route claims through manager approval and finance verification with delegation and SLA reminders via `business-building-blocks-shared-minimal-approvals-building-block` and `business-building-blocks-background-jobs-and-scheduling`, with integration tests (tag bridge, retired by `approvals-workflow-consumer-migration`).

subPhases.title: Settlement and posting
subPhases.scope: Settle approved claims through `finance-banking-payout-batches` payout batches or as a payroll add-on, post journals to the ledger and push GSTIN-bearing receipts into the `finance-expenses-itc-and-gstr-2b-ims-reconciliation` purchase register, with tests.

subPhases.title: Web: my expenses and approver inbox
subPhases.scope: Build the mobile-first 'my expenses' flow with camera upload and the approver inbox, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: finance queue and policy configuration
subPhases.scope: Build the finance settlement queue and policy configuration pages, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: receipt intelligence
subPhases.scope: Add Finance/Reimbursements/Ai for receipt OCR into claim lines, policy-violation explanations, category suggestions and monthly spend summaries.

phases.title: Finance / Payroll (Indian Statutory)
phases.goal: Run compliant monthly payroll with PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS on salary, payslips, statutory files and full-and-final settlements; manual LOP/arrears until HR automates them.

subPhases.title: Salary structures and payroll profiles
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Finance/Payroll/Structures in schema `payroll` with a component library (basic, HRA, special, LTA, allowances, employer PF/NPS, perquisites), CTC templates validated against the Code on Wages 50% rule, effective-dated revisions, grades and employee payroll profiles (PAN, UAN, ESIC IP number, bank account, PF/ESI applicability, regime election), with tests.

subPhases.title: PF, ESI, PT and LWF engines
subPhases.scope: Implement Finance/Payroll/Statutory computing PF (employee 12%, EPS on ceiling, EPF, EDLI, admin charges, excluded employees, VPF), ESI (employee and employer rates, wage ceiling, daily-wage exemption, half-yearly period lock), professional tax by State slab and LWF from `business-building-blocks-statutory-datasets-direct-tax-and-labour` parameter sets, verified by golden-value tests.

subPhases.title: Income tax on salary
subPhases.scope: Implement Finance/Payroll/IncomeTax with per-employee per-tax-year regime election (default new), slabs, Section 87A rebate with marginal relief, standard deduction, 80CCD(2), old-regime declarations (Form 12BB, HRA/LTA/80C/80D), previous-employer income, perquisites (12BA), monthly projection with true-up and ITA-2025 section mapping, pinned by test cases per regime.

subPhases.title: Payroll run pipeline
subPhases.scope: Build Finance/Payroll/Runs with manual LOP/arrears input (tag bridge, automated by `hr-core-leave-management`/`hr-core-attendance`), reimbursement and loan inputs, preview with variance versus previous month, approval, journal posting, `finance-banking-payout-batches` payout batch creation, lock and controlled rerun, and payslip PDFs meeting Code on Wages wage-slip requirements.

subPhases.title: Statutory outputs: PF, ESI and PT
subPhases.scope: Generate the PF ECR file, ESI contribution file and State PT return data with reconciliation reports validated against sample files.

subPhases.title: Statutory outputs: salary TDS and registers
subPhases.scope: Generate the salary TDS challan batch and quarterly statement extract (form numbering verified against ITA-2025 rules), Form 16 Part B, and statutory registers (wages, bonus, gratuity nominations) with fixture tests.

subPhases.title: Full-and-final and benefits
subPhases.scope: Compute F&F within the two-working-day timeline including notice pay, leave encashment with the statutory exemption, gratuity (15/26 formula, five-year and fixed-term rules, cap), statutory bonus (8.33-20%) and loan/advance recovery from `business-building-blocks-statutory-datasets-direct-tax-and-labour` parameters, with a settlement statement PDF and unit tests.

subPhases.title: Web: structure designer and run wizard
subPhases.scope: Build the salary structure designer, employee payroll profile and the run wizard with variance highlights and statutory report downloads, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: employee payslip portal and declarations
subPhases.scope: Build the employee payslip portal and tax-declaration submission with proof upload, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: payroll assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Finance/Payroll/Ai with a regime-recommendation simulator per employee, payroll variance explanations and guarded natural-language payroll queries.

phases.title: Statutory Compliance Calendar, Filings & Company Secretarial
phases.goal: Never miss a statutory deadline: a compliance calendar with evidence tracking, GST/TDS/income-tax filing packs and workspaces, company-law records, ROC tracker and labour-law registers; closes M6.

subPhases.title: Compliance calendar engine
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Compliance/Calendar in schema `compliance` with rule-driven obligations keyed to the financial year (monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, annual, State-specific), owner assignment, reminders and escalation via `business-building-blocks-background-jobs-and-scheduling` and `business-building-blocks-minimal-transactional-email-sender`, evidence attachments (challan/ARN/SRN), completion audit and weekend/holiday adjustment, seeded from a tested JSON rule set.

subPhases.title: GST filing packs
subPhases.scope: Produce GSTR-1/IFF and GSTR-3B computations (outward, RCM 3.1(d), ITC 4, set-off order) for monthly and QRMP modes, GSTR-9/9C threshold checks, LUT renewal reminders, amendment cut-off tracking and an RFD-01 export refund data pack, exported as offline-tool JSON and reconciled against filed figures.

subPhases.title: Filing workspaces
subPhases.scope: Add period-close checklists for GSTR-1/3B, quarterly TDS statements and monthly PF/ESI that pull extracts from `finance-sales`, `finance-expenses` and `finance-payroll` with reconciliation summaries, evidence capture and sign-off, with tests.

subPhases.title: Income-tax filing packs: TDS and disallowances
subPhases.scope: Provide the advance-tax instalment calculator (15/45/75/100), FVU-ready TDS statement CSV extracts, 26AS/AIS reconciliation and the Section 40(a)(ia) and 43B(h) disallowance reports, with unit tests.

subPhases.title: Income-tax filing packs: company return
subPhases.scope: Provide a Form 15CA/15CB-equivalent register for foreign remittances (numbering verified against ITA-2025 rules), a 44AB tax-audit threshold monitor, the company income-tax computation from `business-building-blocks-statutory-datasets-direct-tax-and-labour` parameters and an ITR-6 data pack, with tests.

subPhases.title: Company secretarial records
subPhases.scope: Create Compliance/Corporate with entity profile, directors and KMP with DIN and DIR-3 KYC dates, share capital and cap table with allotments, and statutory registers, with endpoints and tests.

subPhases.title: Meetings and ROC filings
subPhases.scope: Add a board/AGM meeting log with gap rules, resolution templates and minutes, and a ROC filing tracker (AOC-4, MGT-7A, ADT-1, DPT-3, MSME-1, INC-20A, PAS-3, SH-7) linked to the calendar, with tests.

subPhases.title: Labour-law and POSH registers
subPhases.scope: Maintain registers required under the Labour Codes (wages, overtime, leave, bonus, gratuity nominations), PF/ESI registration data, shop-and-establishment records and POSH internal-committee constitution and annual return tracking, with export to prescribed layouts.

subPhases.title: Web: compliance calendar, filings and corporate records
subPhases.scope: Build the compliance calendar (month and list views, overdue heat-map), filing-pack and workspace pages with export buttons, and corporate-record pages, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: compliance assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Compliance/Ai for deadline-risk scoring, a 'what changed' digest generated from statutory parameter-set diffs and draft board-resolution text from templates.

phases.title: Timesheets
phases.goal: Capture employee and contractor time against client engagements (projects once `projects` lands) with approvals, a billing feed and utilisation analytics.

subPhases.title: Timesheet aggregate
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Timesheets/Core in schema `timesheets` with weekly/daily entries against client engagements (`clients-engagements-and-rate-cards`) or internal activity codes with optional task text (tag bridge, upgraded to project/task references by `projects-project-aggregate-and-timesheet-migration`), hours, billable flag, notes, submission periods, lock rules and contractor timesheets tied to vendor contracts, with tests.

subPhases.title: Timesheet rules
subPhases.scope: Implement overlap and daily/weekly cap validation, national plus company holiday calendars, a leave integration hook (tag bridge, wired by `hr-core-leave-management`) and billable-rate resolution from engagement rate cards, with unit tests.

subPhases.title: Approvals and reminders
subPhases.scope: Implement manager/engagement-lead approval with rejection reasons, delegate approvers and missing-timesheet reminders through `business-building-blocks-shared-minimal-approvals-building-block` and `business-building-blocks-background-jobs-and-scheduling` (tag bridge, retired by `approvals-workflow-consumer-migration`).

subPhases.title: Billing feed
subPhases.scope: Convert approved billable hours into invoice draft lines through the `finance-sales-recurring-and-retainer-billing` contract using rate cards, accrue contractor bills from approved contractor time into `finance-expenses`, support fixed-price milestone mapping and track write-downs/write-offs, with integration tests.

subPhases.title: Utilisation analytics
subPhases.scope: Compute billable utilisation per person, team and client, capacity views, overtime flags and exports, exposed as dashboard widgets.

subPhases.title: Web: weekly grid and mobile entry
subPhases.scope: Build a keyboard-driven weekly grid, mobile daily entry with timer and calendar view, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: approvals and utilisation
subPhases.scope: Build the approver inbox and utilisation dashboard, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: timesheet drafting
subPhases.scope: Add Timesheets/Ai to draft entries from pasted calendar/commit summaries (connectors via `operations-hardening` later), parse natural-language entries such as '3h Acme API review', and detect duplicate or over-capacity entries.

phases.title: Approvals & Workflow Engine
phases.goal: Replace the shared minimal approvals block with a configurable, auditable workflow engine used by expenses, bills, payouts, timesheets, leave, procurement and more.

subPhases.title: Workflow definitions
subPhases.scope: Create backend/BuildingBlocks/Workflow with declarative versioned definitions (steps, approver resolution by manager chain, role, user or amount band, sequential/parallel, conditions), validation and seeded defaults per document type, with tests.

subPhases.title: Workflow runtime
subPhases.scope: Implement instances bound to any aggregate through a generic reference, a task inbox model, actions (approve, reject, return, delegate, escalate), SLA timers and reminders via jobs, an audit trail and idempotent transitions proven by concurrency tests.

subPhases.title: Consumer migration
subPhases.scope: Move vendors KYC, bills, payout batches, reimbursements, timesheets and invoices from `business-building-blocks-shared-minimal-approvals-building-block` onto the engine behind feature flags with regression tests proving identical outcomes, then retire `business-building-blocks-shared-minimal-approvals-building-block`.

subPhases.title: Web: inbox and designer
subPhases.scope: Build a unified approvals inbox with keyboard actions, a form-based workflow designer, instance timeline and mobile-first approve/reject, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Policies and controls
subPhases.scope: Enforce segregation of duties (maker not equal to checker), amount thresholds, out-of-office delegation, mandatory rejection comments and a pending-approvals-by-age report.

subPhases.title: AI: approval assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Workflow/Ai summarising what is being approved with risk highlights, suggesting approvers when resolution fails and drafting rejection reasons.

phases.title: Notifications & Emailing
phases.goal: Generalise the minimal email sender into a full notification platform with in-app, email and additional channels, templates, preferences, digests and delivery tracking.

subPhases.title: Notification core
subPhases.scope: Create backend/BuildingBlocks/Notifications with a notification aggregate (type, recipient, payload, channels, read state), subscriptions to `business-building-blocks-transactional-outbox-and-integration-events` integration events, digest batching, per-type/channel user preferences and an in-app bell updated over Server-Sent Events, with tests.

subPhases.title: Email channel
subPhases.scope: Promote `business-building-blocks-minimal-transactional-email-sender` into a provider abstraction with Microsoft Graph sendMail and SMTP fallback implementations, a queued background sender with retries, bounce handling and delivery-status tracking, keeping the dev mail sink, with fake-transport tests.

subPhases.title: Transactional templates
subPhases.scope: Ship templates for invoice/credit-note delivery, payment receipt, dunning ladder, approval requests, payslip release, compliance reminders and invitations, each with preview, test send and snapshot tests.

subPhases.title: Web: notification centre and templates
subPhases.scope: Build the notification centre, preferences page, template management with preview and delivery logs, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Scheduled reminders and digests
subPhases.scope: Send compliance deadline, invoice due and pending-approval reminders and daily digests from the `business-building-blocks-background-jobs-and-scheduling` scheduler with per-user preferences, with tests.

subPhases.title: Additional channels
subPhases.scope: Add Microsoft Teams adaptive-card webhooks, an SMS/WhatsApp provider adapter interface with a fake implementation, and web push hooks consumed by `mobile-pwa`.

subPhases.title: AI: communication assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Notifications/Ai for tone-adjusted reminder drafting, daily digest summaries and notification prioritisation.

phases.title: Documents & Records Management
phases.goal: Extend the attachments building block into full records management: collections, versions, permissions, retention, generated documents, search/OCR, templates and e-signature; closes M9.

subPhases.title: Document model and permissions
subPhases.scope: Extend `backend-platform-attachments-building-block` into backend/BuildingBlocks/Documents with collections per module entity, versions, tags, ownership, permission inheritance from the linked entity, access audit, legal hold and retention policies enforced by a job, migrating existing attachment metadata in place, with tests.

subPhases.title: Generated documents service
subPhases.scope: Consolidate PDF generation (invoices, credit notes, payslips, Form 16, purchase orders, letters) on a shared template engine with branding, QR codes, watermarks and a digital-signature (DSC) integration point, with snapshot tests and migration of `finance-sales-invoice-pdf-rendering` and `finance-payroll-statutory-outputs-salary-tds-and-registers` renderers.

subPhases.title: Search and OCR
subPhases.scope: Index metadata and extracted text with SQL Server full-text search, run OCR through `ai-platform-document-intelligence-pipeline` for scanned uploads and support saved searches, with tests.

subPhases.title: Web: document explorer
subPhases.scope: Build a document explorer, entity document tabs across modules, drag-and-drop upload with progress, PDF/image previewer and version history, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Templates and e-signature
subPhases.scope: Add a template library (NDA, offer letter, contractor agreement) with merge fields and an e-signature request adapter interface storing signed documents.

subPhases.title: AI: document intelligence
subPhases.scope: Add Documents/Ai for auto-tagging and classification, contract clause and renewal-date extraction and semantic search.

phases.title: HR Core: Employee Lifecycle, Leave & Attendance
phases.goal: Manage the employee journey from onboarding to exit, leave and attendance feeding payroll, HR policies and letters, and the employee self-service portal.

subPhases.title: Employee master extension
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Hr/Employees in schema `hr` extending users with personal details, masked statutory ids (PAN, Aadhaar last digits, UAN, ESIC), bank, emergency contacts, documents, employment history, probation/confirmation and effective-dated changes with field-level privacy controls, with tests.

subPhases.title: Onboarding and offboarding
subPhases.scope: Implement cross-team checklists (IT, Finance, HR), offer-to-joining flow with KYC document collection, asset issue hooks to `procurement-assets`, and an exit process covering notice, clearance, F&F trigger to `finance-payroll-full-and-final-and-benefits` and access revocation to `user-management-user-lifecycle`, with tests.

subPhases.title: Leave management
subPhases.scope: Create Hr/Leave with leave types and policies (earned, casual, sick, comp-off, accrual, carry-forward, encashment per Labour Codes), State holiday calendars, requests through `approvals-workflow`, balances, the LOP feed into `finance-payroll-payroll-run-pipeline` and the `timesheets-timesheet-rules` timesheet hook, with tests.

subPhases.title: Attendance
subPhases.scope: Create Hr/Attendance with web/mobile check-in, timesheet-derived presence option, regularisation requests, shift and WFH policies, overtime capture at the statutory rate and monthly lock feeding `finance-payroll-payroll-run-pipeline`, with tests.

subPhases.title: Web: employee self-service portal
subPhases.scope: Build mobile-first pages for my profile, documents and payslips, leave, attendance, tax declarations and team calendar, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: HR admin and manager pages
subPhases.scope: Build HR admin and manager pages for onboarding/offboarding checklists, leave and attendance administration and policies, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: HR policies and letters
subPhases.scope: Provide a policy library with acknowledgement tracking and letter generation (offer, appointment, increment, experience) through `documents` templates.

subPhases.title: AI: HR assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Hr/Ai with a policy Q&A assistant grounded on policy documents, leave-request drafting with conflict detection and onboarding checklist suggestions.

phases.title: HR Talent: Recruitment, Performance & Learning
phases.goal: Grow the team with hiring pipelines, performance and compensation cycles, skills and learning tracking and engagement surveys; closes M10.

subPhases.title: Recruitment
subPhases.scope: Create Hr/Recruitment with job requisitions approved via `approvals-workflow`, candidate pipeline stages, interview scheduling through Graph calendar, scorecards, offer generation via templates and a careers JSON feed, with tests.

subPhases.title: Performance management
subPhases.scope: Create Hr/Performance with goal setting, review cycles collecting self/manager/peer input, calibration, rating scales and history, with tests.

subPhases.title: Compensation cycles
subPhases.scope: Create Hr/Compensation with increment cycles, band structures, budget versus actual and revision letters that update `finance-payroll-salary-structures-and-payroll-profiles` salary structures, with tests.

subPhases.title: Skills and learning
subPhases.scope: Create Hr/Learning with a skills matrix, certifications with expiry reminders, training records and budgets and learning requests, with tests.

subPhases.title: Engagement surveys
subPhases.scope: Add pulse surveys and eNPS with anonymous responses aggregated only above a minimum respondent threshold, with tests.

subPhases.title: Web: recruitment and performance
subPhases.scope: Build recruitment pipeline board, interview and offer screens and performance cycle pages, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: compensation, learning and surveys
subPhases.scope: Build compensation cycle, skills/learning and survey screens, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: talent assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Hr/Talent/Ai for resume parsing into candidate profiles, interview question suggestions, review-summary drafting with bias checks and skills-gap analysis.

phases.title: Projects & Delivery Management
phases.goal: Plan and track client and internal projects with tasks, milestones, budgets, resourcing and profitability, upgrading timesheets to project/task references; closes M7.

subPhases.title: Project aggregate and timesheet migration
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Projects/Core in schema `projects` with project types, phases, milestones linked to billing, team assignments with roles and rates, hour/amount budgets, status and health, templates, and migrate timesheets to project/task references (retires the `timesheets-timesheet-aggregate` bridge), with tests.

subPhases.title: Tasks and boards
subPhases.scope: Add tasks with estimates, assignees, dependencies, sprints, comments and attachments with kanban and list views, with tests.

subPhases.title: Profitability and budgets
subPhases.scope: Compute cost (payroll-rate loaded) versus revenue (invoiced and accrued) per project, WIP and unbilled revenue, burn charts and variance alerts, with tests.

subPhases.title: Client status reporting and change requests
subPhases.scope: Generate shareable milestone/status reports (PDF/email) and record change requests that amend the SOW and budgets, with tests.

subPhases.title: Resource planning
subPhases.scope: Provide an allocation calendar, capacity versus demand, bench report and conflict detection with leave from `hr-core-leave-management`, with tests.

subPhases.title: Web: portfolio, project 360 and boards
subPhases.scope: Build the portfolio dashboard, project 360 and task boards, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: timeline and resource planner
