subPhases.scope: Build the timeline view, resource planner and profitability views, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: delivery assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Projects/Ai for status-report drafting from tasks and timesheets, schedule/budget risk detection and effort-estimation suggestions from history.

phases.title: Procurement, Subscriptions & Assets
phases.goal: Control spend before it happens with requisitions, purchase orders, receipt matching, subscription and licence management and sourcing, and track fixed assets and IT equipment from purchase to disposal with depreciation, assignment and verification.

subPhases.title: Requisitions
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Procurement/Requisitions in schema `procurement` with purchase requests, budget checks, categories, justification, `approvals-workflow` approvals and conversion to purchase orders, with tests.

subPhases.title: Purchase orders
subPhases.scope: Create Procurement/Orders issuing POs with GST-treatment preview from `finance-core-gst-tax-engine`, amendments, PDF/email delivery, acknowledgement tracking and closure, with tests.

subPhases.title: Receipts and three-way match
subPhases.scope: Record goods/service receipt notes and match PO, receipt and `finance-expenses` bill within tolerances with a discrepancy workflow, with tests.

subPhases.title: Subscriptions and licences
subPhases.scope: Create Procurement/Subscriptions as a SaaS/licence inventory with seats, owners, renewal dates, costs, auto-renew flags, cancellation reminders and spend analytics fed by `finance-expenses-recurring-expenses-and-subscriptions-feed` recurring bills, with tests.

subPhases.title: Sourcing
subPhases.scope: Support RFQs, quote comparison, preferred-vendor rules and contract linkage to `vendors-contractor-agreements`, with tests.

subPhases.title: Asset register
subPhases.scope: Create backend/Modules/Assets/Register in schema `assets` with asset classes, capitalisation from `finance-expenses` bills, tags/serials, location, custodian, warranty, insurance and documents, with tests.

subPhases.title: Depreciation
subPhases.scope: Create Assets/Depreciation with Companies Act Schedule II useful lives (SLM/WDV) and income-tax block rates from `business-building-blocks-statutory-datasets-direct-tax-and-labour`, a monthly depreciation run posting `finance-core` journals and a fixed-asset register report verified by golden tests.

subPhases.title: Asset assignment and lifecycle
subPhases.scope: Handle issue/return to employees with `hr-core-onboarding-and-offboarding` onboarding/offboarding hooks, transfers, maintenance records and disposal/sale with gain-loss journals, with tests.

subPhases.title: IT and software inventory
subPhases.scope: Track devices with OS/patch and security attestation fields (disk encryption, MDM) and link software licences to `procurement-assets-subscriptions-and-licences` subscriptions, with tests.

subPhases.title: Web: requisitions, orders, receipts and sourcing
subPhases.scope: Build screens for requisitions, purchase orders, receipts/three-way match and sourcing, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: Web: subscriptions and assets
subPhases.scope: Build the subscription inventory, asset register, asset 360, QR label printing and a mobile physical-verification mode with camera scanning, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: procurement and asset assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Procurement/Ai and Assets/Ai for requisition classification, overlap detection with existing subscriptions, quote comparison summaries, renewal negotiation briefs, asset classification and useful-life suggestion from bill descriptions.

phases.title: Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics
phases.goal: Give every role live dashboards, statutory and management reports, exports and a self-service report builder over read-optimised models.

subPhases.title: Reporting infrastructure
subPhases.scope: Create backend/BuildingBlocks/Reporting with read models refreshed from `business-building-blocks-transactional-outbox-and-integration-events` events, a report-definition abstraction (parameters, dataset, layout), Excel/CSV/PDF export and scheduled delivery through `notifications`, with tests.

subPhases.title: Role dashboards
subPhases.scope: Build owner (cash, receivables, payables, runway, compliance status), finance, HR and delivery/utilisation dashboards with drill-down and date ranges over a module widget registry; the owner dashboard may be pulled forward by order override after M5.

subPhases.title: Financial statements and MIS
subPhases.scope: Deliver Schedule III P&L and balance sheet, cash-flow statement, budget versus actual, cost-centre and project profitability and GST/TDS liability summaries, with fixture tests.

subPhases.title: People and operations reports
subPhases.scope: Implement headcount, payroll cost, utilisation, timesheet compliance and leave reports, with tests.

subPhases.title: Self-service report builder
subPhases.scope: Provide a field picker over curated datasets with filters, grouping, charts and saved/shared reports with permissions, with tests.

subPhases.title: Data export and warehouse hooks
subPhases.scope: Add nightly Parquet/CSV exports to a volume, Power BI/Excel connection guidance and a data dictionary with privacy classifications.

subPhases.title: Web: dashboards and reports
subPhases.scope: Build dashboards and reports with accessible light/dark charts, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshot baselines.

subPhases.title: AI: analytics assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Reporting/Ai for natural-language-to-report definitions with preview, narrative insights on dashboards and anomaly alerts.

phases.title: Integrations Platform & Public API
phases.goal: Connect the ERP to the outside world with a connector framework, public API and webhooks, Microsoft 365, engineering-tool, government/tax and banking connectors and an import/export centre; closes M12.

subPhases.title: Integration framework
subPhases.scope: Create backend/BuildingBlocks/Integrations with a connector abstraction (auth, sync jobs, mapping, error handling, replay), per-connection secrets in Key Vault, connection health, rate-limit awareness and idempotency, with a fake connector under test.

subPhases.title: Public API and webhooks
subPhases.scope: Expose a versioned public API secured by `authentication-session-endpoints-openapi-security-and-bearer` bearer tokens or API keys with scopes, hashing and rotation, outbound webhook subscriptions with HMAC signatures and retries, per-client rate limits and a developer documentation page, with integration tests.

subPhases.title: Microsoft 365 connectors
subPhases.scope: Integrate Graph calendar (interviews, leave), SharePoint/OneDrive document sync and Teams notifications with contract tests against recorded responses.

subPhases.title: Engineering tool connectors
subPhases.scope: Integrate GitHub, Azure DevOps and Jira for timesheet hints and project task sync, with contract tests.

subPhases.title: GST and identity connectors
subPhases.scope: Implement adapter interfaces and sandbox tests for GST/GSP APIs (GSTR-2B download, live e-invoice IRP over `finance-sales-e-invoicing-adapter`) and PAN/GSTIN verification, each behind feature flags.

subPhases.title: Direct-tax and labour connectors
subPhases.scope: Implement TRACES/26AS ingestion, EPFO ECR and ESIC file validators and exchange-rate feeds, each behind feature flags with contract tests.

subPhases.title: Banking and payment connectors
subPhases.scope: Add bank statement API/host-to-host adapters where available and a payment-gateway adapter interface for client receipts with webhook reconciliation into `finance-banking`, with tests.

subPhases.title: Import/export centre
subPhases.scope: Provide a generic CSV/Excel import framework with mapping templates, dry-run and error reports, bulk export, and migration importers for Tally/Zoho/QuickBooks formats, with tests.

subPhases.title: Web: integrations admin
subPhases.scope: Build admin pages for API keys, webhooks, connectors, import jobs and delivery logs, covered by Playwright on desktop and mobile with screenshots.

subPhases.title: AI: integration assistant
subPhases.scope: Add Integrations/Ai for import-mapping suggestions and error-triage explanations for failed syncs.

phases.title: Operations: Observability, DR, Security Hardening & Privacy
phases.goal: Make production boring with a telemetry backend, tested disaster recovery, security posture gates and automation, performance management, an admin console, runbooks and DPDP Act compliance.

subPhases.title: Production telemetry backend
subPhases.scope: Decide by ADR with owner approval between a self-hosted OTLP stack compose profile on the server and Azure Monitor, deploy it, build golden-signal dashboards and alert routing to email/Teams, and set log retention.

subPhases.title: Disaster recovery
subPhases.scope: Configure Azure SQL long-term retention and geo-restore, encrypted off-site backups of documents and key volumes, quarterly restore drills with recorded RTO/RPO and a server-loss DR runbook rebuilding from images and backups.

subPhases.title: Security posture: gates and checklist
subPhases.scope: Run CodeQL security-extended, image scans and dependency audits as merge gates, add e2e verification of security headers and CSRF protections, and track an OWASP ASVS checklist in the repo with findings fixed.

subPhases.title: Security posture: rotation and access review
subPhases.scope: Automate secret and certificate rotation, add periodic access-review screens, and document Entra Conditional Access recommendations.

subPhases.title: Performance and capacity
subPhases.scope: Add load tests for key endpoints, a Query Store based slow-query report, an index review job, a caching review and a capacity dashboard with thresholds and a CI performance smoke check.

subPhases.title: Admin console
subPhases.scope: Build an admin console for feature flags, jobs, outbox, cache purge and maintenance mode, an audit-log explorer and an approved, audited data-fix script framework, covered by Playwright.

subPhases.title: Runbooks and incident process
subPhases.scope: Write incident and postmortem templates, an on-call checklist, upgrade runbooks (.NET, Next.js, SQL, base images) and a dependency-upgrade cadence policy.

subPhases.title: Data privacy compliance (DPDP)
subPhases.scope: Implement DPDP Act obligations (notice/consent records, data-principal requests, breach notification workflow), data classification, retention/purge jobs and employee data export, with tests.

phases.title: Mobile, PWA & Offline
